source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape painting with layered river scenery: misty distant hills, a pine-crowned island mountain, open water, wooded banks, foreground rocks, bamboo, pines, a thatched pavilion, and small boats. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: misty_distant_mountain_range
motifs.description: Soft blue-gray distant mountain silhouettes along the upper-left horizon, partly submerged in pale mist above the water.

motifs.name: central_pine_crowned_mountain_island
motifs.description: Main upper island mountain with ochre-green slopes, dark ink rock ridges, clustered pines along the crest, wooded base, and narrow shoreline strokes.
must_preserve: thin horizontal shoreline and waterline strokes

motifs.name: right_misty_far_shore
motifs.description: Small distant right-side shoreline with low hills, faint trees or settlement-like marks, and a narrow sandy bank emerging through mist.

motifs.name: mid_left_marshy_riverbank
motifs.description: Middle-left low riverbank with hazy shrubs, sparse reed-like tree trunks, a small inlet, and horizontal water strokes.
must_preserve: fine vertical reed and trunk lines

motifs.name: right_pavilion_pines_bamboo
motifs.description: Right foreground group with tall straight pines, bamboo stalks and leaves, rocky slope, and a small thatched pavilion roof beside the water.
must_preserve: tall pine trunks with dark needle clusters
bamboo leaf clusters and jointed stems

motifs.name: central_foreground_willow_terrace
motifs.description: Central foreground terrace of rounded rocks and grassy banks with a leaning willow, clustered shrubs, small upright trees, and stream-edge rocks.

motifs.name: lower_left_boat_bank
motifs.description: Lower-left waterside bank with overhanging sparse tree, small boat on the water, reeds, and low rocks at the shoreline.

motifs.name: foreground_monolithic_rock_bamboo_gully
motifs.description: Large lower foreground vertical rock mass and gully with bamboo clumps, shrubs, a small hidden roof or structure at its base, and layered grassy slopes.
must_preserve: small roof geometry tucked below rock
dark crevice lines and mossy shrub dots

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
